messages:
maria (eng-platform): Heads-up — planning to cut the API/SDK v2.4 staged rollout tonight. Need owners for deploy, smoke, and rollback readiness. Target window: 23:00-00:30 PT. Who can take the lead and confirm the quick checks?
kevin (eng-sre): I can own infra/watch during the window. Will be online at 22:45 PT.
alex (release-engineer): I'll drive the canary deploy. Plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m soak between steps. I’ll run the smoke script after each step.
sophia (product): Quick reminder: client-notify email goes out at T-2h. Jen, can you confirm copy?
jen (client-plat): Confirmed — email approved. Sending at 21:00 PT. Also posting a short note to the SDK changelog + breaking changes doc link.
maria (eng-platform): Thanks. Alex — can you paste the smoke checklist here so SRE/product can see?
alex (release-engineer): Sure. Smoke checklist (short):
```
- svc health endpoints ok
- 95th p99 latency within baseline (<120ms)
- error rate <0.5% for api/generate
- integration test: client-auth + streaming example
- embeddings endpoint sanity check (small vector)
```
I’ll run: `./scripts/smoke-run --canary` (logs to /var/log/deploys/v2.4)
kevin (eng-sre): Add: verify autoscaler pods stable and node metrics normal. I’ll watch prometheus and infra alerts. If p95 jumps >2x I'll call rollback.
sophia (product): For compatibility: we've added the `response_mode` param but default behavior unchanged. We need to ensure SDKs default to old behavior. Alex — confirm SDK clients keep previous defaults?
alex (release-engineer): Yes, v2.4 SDKs include the opt-in param, defaults unchanged. We'll also ship a small client compatibility test as part of smoke: run `client-tests/compat.sh` against canary.
jen (client-plat): I'll run client tests from CI post-5% rollout and report pass/fail in thread.
maria (eng-platform): Rollback playbook? Keep it simple: stop canary routing, redeploy previous model/binary, revoke canary keys, and run smoke again. Alex, can you list exact commands?
alex (release-engineer): Rollback quick commands:
```
# remove canary traffic
infractl traffic set api-v2 --tag canary --pct 0
# redeploy prior image
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/api-serving api-serving=redwood/api:v2.3.18
# restart svc
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/api-serving
# sanity checks
./scripts/smoke-run --target v2.3.18
```
If rollback happens, we do not advance to next bucket. Notify #incidents and ops-oncall.
kevin (eng-sre): Agreed. Also, I'll prepare a fail-open policy: if downstream quota errors spike, auto-fallback to smaller model pool (config key: routing.fallback_model). I'll monitor that.
sophia (product): Client comms: post-launch note (T+1h) with migration tips and how to opt-in to new param. Jen will trigger.
jen (client-plat): Will post T+1h. Also will update the SDK README with the example snippet.
maria (eng-platform): Deployment timeline recap: 22:45 — ops/infra oncall check-in; 23:00 — start 5% canary; 23:10 — smoke + client tests; 23:20 — move to 25%; 23:30 — smoke; 23:40 — final to 100% if green; 23:50 — final smoke and post-launch comms. Any objections?
kevin (eng-sre): No objections. I'll keep the alert escalation list ready.
alex (release-engineer): All good. I’ll tag the canary run in CI and paste the job link here when it starts.
jen (client-plat): Sending T-2h email now (scheduled).
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy for api-sdk:v2.4 at 23:00 PT by alex (release-engineer). Canary buckets configured: 5,25,100.
maria (eng-platform): Perfect. If anything changes ping here @kevin @alex @jen. Post logs to this thread (link them). :thumbsup:
alex (release-engineer): Will do. Uploading smoke run logs and CI link during the rollout.
kevin (eng-sre): I'll post alerts if anything diverges.
sophia (product): Thanks team — will monitor client channels for early issues.
jen (client-plat): Noted. Good luck :rocket:
